messages:
maya: heads up — CI red on PR #842 (linux-asan). Failing test: Serving::PacketRetryBackoffTest. looks timing-y, repro only on the nightly matrix. error snippet: `expected <= 150ms, got 318ms`
aj: ugh. can you paste the full failing log? is there a seed printed?
maya: log attached below (trimmed):
```
--- FAIL: PacketRetryBackoffTest (0.31s)
    backoff_test.cc:88: Expected latency <= 150ms, actual 318.45ms
    random_seed: 7421
    /buildkite/builds/redwood/runtime/serve/backoff_test.cc:88
```
ajs: pinging ci-bot to rerun the flake on the same image 
@ci-bot rerun //runtime/serve:packet_retry_backoff_test --env=linux-asan --seed=7421 :thumbsup:
ci-bot: scheduled rerun for job 842:r1 (linux-asan). queued on runner az-3.
aj: also can someone try a local reproduce with the seed? command: `bazel test //runtime/serve:packet_retry_backoff_test --test_arg=--seed=7421 --test_env=ASAN_OPTIONS=detect_leaks=0`
maya: running locally now, will report back. quick note: this test has flaky history but usually on mac-arm, not linux-asan — odd.
carl: if it repros locally we should bisect the commit range for the PR branch. if it doesn't repro, maybe CI noise (runner busy). also check recent TCP mocking changes (PR #837 touched backoff timer).
maya: local run reproduced once (2/5). adding a tiny repro harness to print timestamps around the retry loop. attaching snippet:
```
// debug:
auto t0 = now();
// ... do send
auto t1 = now();
LOG(INFO) << "retry_delay_ms=" << (t1-t0).count()/1ms << " seed=" << seed;
```
maya: output shows jitter spikes at ~290ms in the first retry attempt. seems like a scheduling hiccup, maybe epoll/wakeup delay under ASAN.
aj: ok can you try `GOMAXPROCS=1` and `taskset` isolate a core to rule out preemption? also try disabling ASAN leak detection as I suggested.
maya: tried GOMAXPROCS=1 and it reduced occurrences (4/10 -> 1/10). taskset reduces further. points to CPU scheduling rather than logic bug.
carl: for now let's mark the test flaky with an issue and add CI rerun flake rule for that test on linux-asan. also open a small follow-up to add a tolerant assert to avoid spurious failures (e.g., <= 450ms on ASAN matrix).
aj: sounds good. @infra-bot can you add a rerun-on-failure entry for `//runtime/serve:packet_retry_backoff_test` in the linux-asan matrix (3 retries)?
infra-bot: created ticket INF-1298 and updated CI config; will backfill for next nightly.
maya: PR update: pushed a temporary test tweak (wider threshold) and added debug logging behind a `--test_arg=--debug-flake` flag. will remove once we root cause. i requested a rerun of PR #842.
aj: thanks. if anyone wants to help with bisect, lemme know and I can coordinate a git bisect run across the PR range.
carl: thanks all — keeping this thread for quick async notes. please drop final status when PR passes on linux-asan.
